decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list to focus on actual backpacks, as the product feed contained many accessories like stoves, tents, and patches. My consideration set included the adidas Hermosa (high rating and brand trust), the MOSISO sling (best-seller style), the G4Free tactical bag (good capacity), the ZOMAKE packable (value/portability), and the OutdoorMaster boot bag (specialized storage). I ultimately selected the adidas Hermosa Mesh Backpack because it has the highest consistent rating (4.7) and is a versatile, full-size option at a reasonable price. Choosing to purchase also aligns with maintaining the overall experiment target of approximately 30% no_purchase decisions.
